title: Bozeman cattle mutilation with UFO reports

tellings.quote: And there was a cattle mutilation, in which two cows were killed and surgically manipulated.

plain: In 1988, near Bozeman, Montana, there was a cattle mutilation, where livestock are found dead and cut up as if by a surgeon: two cows were killed and "surgically manipulated," and there were UFO reports around the same time. Kevin Knuth, presented on the show as a NASA whistleblower, tells Michels this as a witness to the events. If true, the strange deaths and the sightings were linked.
